title: Airport again (VIVID)
content: I did an intense out of body whatever on YouTube, I usually don't do them, but at the last second I remember being thrown into the airport and thinking holy shit I'm here I have to look and remember my surroundings. I remember people walking past me, a man with overalls, Red ticket, Brunette women, red ticket. They were all going to these turnstiles with red tickets, and then I woke up as I was going through. Just my latest experience 🤷🏼‍♀️
